pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal and sub-rectangular dark regions with defined geometric vertices. Edge gradients show a sharp transition from dark brown to light cream, though subject to moderate resolution blurring.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light interstitial pathways forming a grid-like mesh. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, indicating a short, continuous mane structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, ovoid silhouette (consistent with an oxpecker bird) is visible perched on the posterior-most portion of the dorsal ridge.
